parts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated modular equipment reference for image-to-3D reconstruction for a realistic fantasy RPG. Input image is the exact design and material reference: preserve its worn engraved silver steel, warm brown leather, tawny fur, and proportions. Output only the requested empty wearable equipment, with no person, skin, hair, mannequin or body filling the openings. Uniform pale gray background, soft neutral studio illumination, sharp readable surfaces, no hard shadows, text, labels, panels or extra props. One single near-orthographic front view, whole object centered with generous margin. Create ONLY the barbarian horned helmet from the reference. Match the upward and outward sweeping pair of natural brown horns with carved bands, weathered silver steel dome with engraved central ridge, small red forehead gemstone, angular steel cheek guards and completely open eye/nose/mouth area. Hollow dark interior; no head inside. Front view with a very slight elevated angle so the helmet is clearly a hollow wearable shell. Preserve the reference shape closely; no neck armor, hair or shoulders. Natural adult male head fit.

Use case: precise-object-edit. This image is the edit target. Make a clean image-to-3D reference of the SAME barbarian shin wrap, retaining its silver forked vertical reinforcement, brown wrapped leather, silver ankle rim and tawny fur cuff. CHANGE ONLY: replace all background transparency or dark gradients with absolutely solid opaque light gray; make the fur cuff a thick continuous solid tawny fur volume with short broad shaggy tufts, not thin transparent individual hairs. Strong readable chunky fur silhouette all around the top rim. Keep the SINGLE wrap upright and hollow, straight shin tube; the front opening faces camera, top and bottom are clearly open, with NO end caps, feet, soles, body or extra objects. Direct front three-quarter view turned only 8 degrees with minimal perspective. Full object centered with 12% margin. Fur cuff is essential and occupies the upper quarter. Soft diffuse neutral lighting, no text. Aspect ratio of complete greave about 2.5 height to 1 width.

The openings are clearly EMPTY, no end caps, skin, arm, hand, fingers, mannequin, ropes, dangling loops, second object, text or labels. Continuous solid leather tube with crisp visible metal detailing, evenly lit neutral studio image. Full object centered with 12% margin.

textures.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square albedo texture for a realistic fantasy RPG barbarian's worn brown leather equipment. Generate only a FLAT CLOSE-UP MATERIAL SWATCH filling the entire square edge to edge: medium-dark chestnut brown worn leather, dense fine irregular pores and subtle fine creases at a consistent small scale, restrained natural color variation, slightly weathered supple hide. No large folds, wood grain, fur, cloth weave, stitches, border, seams, metal, studs, buckles, straps, objects, labels, lighting highlights or shadows. Orthographic flat material surface, diffuse neutral even illumination. Seamless tileable on all four sides. High-frequency realistic leather texture at a scale of a 20 cm square.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square albedo texture for a realistic fantasy RPG barbarian's tawny fur cuffs. Generate only a FLAT CLOSE-UP MATERIAL SWATCH filling the entire square edge to edge: dense layered tawny brown and warm beige animal fur, mostly medium brown roots and small beige tips, short thick overlapping natural tufts with fine hair strands. Fur flows predominantly downward with gently varying tuft directions. Keep the hair texture fine at a consistent scale like a 20 cm square of hide. No white patches, no large sweeping waves, no wood grain, no leather, metal, straps, buttons, studs, seams, border, objects, text or labels. Uniform diffuse neutral lighting without directional shadow or highlights. Seamless tileable left-right and top-bottom. Realistic game material albedo, not an object photograph.

pants_revision.fit: Decorated belt fitted radially to the actual waist, rear belt follows body sections with 13 mm outer clearance. pants_revision.retained_body: Body geometry and skin weights unchanged; covered_skin replaced with restored_skin using existing skin texture UV islands in the subsequent waist_layout_skin_revision.

pants_revision.runtime_simulation: Front/back pelts retain 1/60 s rigid pendulums. Two side pelts and four straps use 330 Verlet particles at 1/120 s with two fixed top rows, distance/shear/bending constraints, body ellipsoid contacts, and a 4% upper bound on vertical segment extension. Compression and folds are allowed. Belt attachment positions and normals are restored exactly. Free normals and shell thickness follow the deformed grid.

The attached character image is a COLOR AND MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY. Generate ONLY a flat square swatch of warm light tan human skin matching the reference's upper thigh and abdomen, evenly lit without directional lighting, very subtle fine pores and faint natural mottling. This is a surface texture tile, NOT a picture of a person or body part. Edge-to-edge uniform skin, no clothing, seams, folds, hairs, freckles, scars, limbs, anatomy, text, black borders, highlights, large blotches, or shadows. Fine pore density suitable for a 45-centimeter wide skin surface. All four edges must tile seamlessly. Low contrast, photorealistic PBR base-color swatch. Do not depict any person, pose, genitals, or body contours.
